heading.title: Of Offences Against Woman and Child

article.title: Kidnapping or abducting child under ten years of age with intent to steal from its person
article.content: Whoever kidnaps or abducts any child under the age of ten years with the intention of taking dishonestly any movable property from the person of such child, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
article.html:
97Kidnapping or abducting child under ten years of age with intent to steal from its person

Section 97 · Chapter V · Of offences against child

Whoever kidnaps or abducts any child under the age of ten years with the intention of taking dishonestly any movable property from the person of such child, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
